v.1: Blessed is the man who doesn't walk in the counsel of the wicked, Nor stand in the way of sinners, Nor sit in the seat of scoffers;
v.2: But his delight is in Yahweh's law; On his law he meditates day and night.
v.3: He will be like a tree planted by the streams of water, That brings forth its fruit in its season, Whose leaf also does not wither. Whatever he does shall prosper.
v.4: The wicked are not so, But are like the chaff which the wind drives away.
v.5: Therefore the wicked shall not stand in the judgment, Nor sinners in the congregation of the righteous.
v.6: For Yahweh knows the way of the righteous, But the way of the wicked shall perish.
